steps.title: 👋 Welcome to Config Portal
steps.description: Manage feature flags and remote configuration for your apps — completely free. Let's get started by creating your first project.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description: A project groups all your configs for one app or service. Click here to get started.

steps.title: 🌍 Nice! Now add an environment
steps.description: Environments let you have different config values for development, staging, and production.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.description: Click here to create an environment.

steps.title: 🚀 Ready to create your first config
steps.description: You have a project and environment set up. Now let's add a feature flag or config value.

steps.title: Go to Configs
steps.description: Click the Configs tab to manage your flags.

steps.title: Create a config
steps.description: Click here to add your first feature flag.

steps.title: 🎉 Awesome!
steps.description: Your first config is created. You can now target users, schedule changes, set up rollouts, and more from the expanded config panel.
